title: Continue Statement

lines.explanation: This for loop statement is read in the following way: iterate through each letter in the string 'Python'
it checks if the current letter is 'h'
if the current letter is 'h', it will skip the current iteration of the loop and continue with the next iteration
This statement will print all the letters but the letter 'h' because it skipped the iteration where the current letter was 'h'.
